views.definition:
WITH snapshot AS (
         SELECT catalog_coverage_snapshots.report
           FROM catalog_coverage_snapshots
          WHERE catalog_coverage_snapshots.scope = 'latest'::text
        ), observed AS (
         SELECT x.source_provider,
            x.origin_language,
            x.origin_set,
            x.cards,
            x.reference_missing,
            x.placeholder,
            x.source_printings,
            x.inventory_entries,
            x.printing_entries,
            x.unidentified_entries,
            x.pending_identity,
            x.missing_exact,
            x.candidate_exact,
            x.verified_exact,
            x.unknown_language
           FROM snapshot s
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(s.report -> 'groups'::text) x(source_provider text, origin_language text, origin_set text, cards bigint, reference_missing bigint, placeholder bigint, source_printings bigint, inventory_entries bigint, printing_entries bigint, unidentified_entries bigint, pending_identity bigint, missing_exact bigint, candidate_exact bigint, verified_exact bigint, unknown_language bigint)
        ), metadata AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.provider, s.source_language, (lower(s.set_id))) s.source_uid,
            s.provider,
            s.source_language,
            lower(s.set_id) AS source_set,
            s.name,
            s.coverage_scope,
            s.reported_count,
            s.manifest_count,
            s.resolved_count,
            s.coverage_checked_at,
            s.coverage_detail,
            r.status,
            r.reason,
            r.source_url,
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.coverage_detail -> 'missing_count'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (s.coverage_detail ->> 'missing_count'::text)::bigint
                    WHEN s.manifest_digest IS NOT NULL AND s.manifest_digest = s.resolved_digest THEN 0::bigint
                    ELSE NULL::bigint
                END AS missing_count,
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.coverage_detail -> 'unexpected_count'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (s.coverage_detail ->> 'unexpected_count'::text)::bigint
                    WHEN (s.coverage_detail ->> 'comparison_scope'::text) = 'expected_source_links'::text THEN NULL::bigint
                    WHEN s.manifest_digest IS NOT NULL AND s.manifest_digest = s.resolved_digest THEN 0::bigint
                    ELSE NULL::bigint
                END AS unexpected_count,
            s.manifest_last_attempt_at,
            s.manifest_last_error
           FROM catalog_sync_sets s
             JOIN catalog_coverage_register r ON r.target_key = s.source_uid AND r.target_type = 'set'::text
          WHERE s.set_id <> '__index__'::text
          ORDER BY s.provider, s.source_language, (lower(s.set_id)), s.coverage_checked_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.source_uid
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(m.source_uid, jsonb_build_array(o.source_provider, o.origin_language, o.origin_set)::text) AS target_key,
    COALESCE(m.provider, o.source_provider) AS provider,
    COALESCE(m.source_language, o.origin_language) AS source_language,
    COALESCE(l.label, 'Lingua non determinata'::text) AS language_label,
    COALESCE(m.source_set, o.origin_set) AS source_set,
    COALESCE(m.name, o.origin_set) AS name,
    COALESCE(m.status, 'unregistered'::text) AS status,
    COALESCE(m.reason, 'Voci importate: manca un elenco di riferimento abbinato con certezza.'::text) ||
        CASE
            WHEN m.manifest_last_error IS NOT NULL THEN ' Ultimo confronto rinviato: '::text || m.manifest_last_error
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS reason,
    m.source_url,
    m.reported_count,
    m.manifest_count,
    m.resolved_count,
    m.coverage_checked_at AS checked_at,
    m.missing_count,
    m.unexpected_count,
    m.coverage_detail,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.cards, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS cards,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.reference_missing, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS reference_missing,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.placeholder, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS placeholder,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.source_printings, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS source_printings,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.inventory_entries, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS inventory_entries,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.printing_entries, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS printing_entries,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.unidentified_entries, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS unidentified_entries,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.pending_identity, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS pending_identity,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.missing_exact, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS missing_exact,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.candidate_exact, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS candidate_exact,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.verified_exact, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS verified_exact,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM snapshot)) AND (o.source_provider IS NOT NULL OR (m.provider = ANY (ARRAY['tcgdex'::text, 'atlas'::text]))) THEN COALESCE(o.unknown_language, 0::bigint)
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS unknown_language,
    m.manifest_last_attempt_at,
    m.manifest_last_error
   FROM metadata m
     FULL JOIN observed o ON o.source_provider = m.provider AND o.origin_language = m.source_language AND o.origin_set = m.source_set
     LEFT JOIN catalog_language_sources l ON l.source_language = COALESCE(m.source_language, o.origin_language)
  WHERE COALESCE(m.coverage_scope, 'unclassified'::text) <> 'digital'::text;

views.name: catalog_coverage_register
views.definition:
WITH sets AS (
         SELECT s.source_uid AS target_key,
            'set'::text AS target_type,
            s.provider,
            s.source_language,
            COALESCE(l.label, s.source_language) AS language_label,
            COALESCE(l.region, 'Da documentare'::text) AS region,
            s.set_id AS release_code,
            s.name,
            s.coverage_scope,
            COALESCE(s.reported_count, s.manifest_count) AS expected_count,
            s.resolved_count,
            s.coverage_checked_at AS checked_at,
            s.next_sync_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN s.coverage_scope = 'digital'::text THEN 'excluded'::text
                    WHEN s.last_sync_at IS NULL THEN 'to_import'::text
                    WHEN s.last_error IS NOT NULL OR s.coverage_scope <> 'physical'::text OR s.coverage_checked_at IS NULL OR s.coverage_checked_at < (now() - '8 days'::interval) OR s.manifest_count IS NULL OR s.manifest_count = 0 OR s.manifest_count IS DISTINCT FROM s.resolved_count OR s.manifest_digest IS NULL OR s.manifest_digest IS DISTINCT FROM s.resolved_digest OR s.reported_count IS NOT NULL AND s.reported_count <> s.manifest_count THEN 'to_review'::text
                    ELSE 'aligned'::text
                END AS status,
                CASE
                    WHEN s.coverage_scope = 'digital'::text THEN 'Pokémon TCG Pocket escluso dal catalogo fisico.'::text
                    WHEN s.last_error IS NOT NULL THEN s.last_error
                    WHEN s.last_sync_at IS NULL THEN 'Prima importazione non completata.'::text
                    WHEN s.coverage_checked_at IS NULL THEN 'Importazione precedente: confronto degli identificativi ancora da registrare.'::text
                    WHEN s.coverage_scope <> 'physical'::text THEN 'Ambito fisico/digitale da classificare.'::text
                    WHEN s.coverage_checked_at < (now() - '8 days'::interval) THEN 'Confronto da aggiornare.'::text
                    WHEN s.manifest_count IS DISTINCT FROM s.resolved_count OR s.manifest_digest IS DISTINCT FROM s.resolved_digest THEN 'Identificativi mancanti o discordanti rispetto all’elenco della fonte.'::text
                    WHEN s.reported_count IS NOT NULL AND s.reported_count <> s.manifest_count THEN 'Quantità dichiarata ed elenco della fonte discordanti.'::text
                    ELSE 'Elenco delle carte confrontato con questa fonte; tutte le varianti non sono certificate.'::text
                END AS reason,
                CASE s.provider
                    WHEN 'tcgdex'::text THEN (('https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/'::text || s.source_language) || '/sets/'::text) || s.set_id
                    ELSE 'https://github.com/type-null/PTCG-database'::text
                END AS source_url,
            'unverified'::text AS variants_status
           FROM catalog_sync_sets s
             LEFT JOIN catalog_language_sources l USING (source_language)
          WHERE s.set_id <> '__index__'::text
        ), language_totals AS (
         SELECT sets.source_language,
            count(*) AS n,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sets.status = 'to_import'::text) AS pending,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sets.status = 'to_review'::text) AS review
           FROM sets
          WHERE sets.provider = 'tcgdex'::text AND sets.coverage_scope <> 'digital'::text
          GROUP BY sets.source_language
        )
 SELECT sets.target_key,
    sets.target_type,
    sets.provider,
    sets.source_language,
    sets.language_label,
    sets.region,
    sets.release_code,
    sets.name,
    sets.coverage_scope,
    sets.expected_count,
    sets.resolved_count,
    sets.checked_at,
    sets.next_sync_at,
    sets.status,
    sets.reason,
    sets.source_url,
    sets.variants_status
   FROM sets
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'language:'::text || l.source_language AS target_key,
    'language'::text AS target_type,
    'tcgdex'::text AS provider,
    l.source_language,
    l.label AS language_label,
    l.region,
    NULL::text AS release_code,
    l.label AS name,
    'physical'::text AS coverage_scope,
    l.listed_sets AS expected_count,
    COALESCE(t.n, 0::bigint)::integer AS resolved_count,
    l.last_probe_at AS checked_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS next_sync_at,
        CASE
            WHEN l.probe_status = ANY (ARRAY['unprobed'::text, 'empty'::text, 'error'::text]) THEN 'not_covered'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(t.n, 0::bigint) = 0 OR t.pending > 0 THEN 'to_import'::text
            ELSE 'to_review'::text
        END AS status,
        CASE
            WHEN l.probe_status = 'error'::text THEN COALESCE(l.last_error, 'Fonte non disponibile al controllo.'::text)
            WHEN l.probe_status = ANY (ARRAY['unprobed'::text, 'empty'::text]) THEN 'Nessun elenco utilizzabile verificato.'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(t.n, 0::bigint) = 0 THEN 'Elenco disponibile: espansioni da scoprire nel prossimo worker aggiornato.'::text
            ELSE 'Percorso linguistico registrato; conteggi in espansioni. La copertura mondiale e le varianti restano da confrontare.'::text
        END AS reason,
    l.source_url,
    'unverified'::text AS variants_status
   FROM catalog_language_sources l
     LEFT JOIN language_totals t USING (source_language)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'release:'::text || r.code AS target_key,
    'release'::text AS target_type,
    'curated'::text AS provider,
    'und'::text AS source_language,
    'Lingue da verificare'::text AS language_label,
    'Distribuzione promozionale'::text AS region,
    r.code AS release_code,
    r.name,
    'physical'::text AS coverage_scope,
    NULL::integer AS expected_count,
    NULL::integer AS resolved_count,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS checked_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS next_sync_at,
    'to_review'::text AS status,
    'Distribuzione registrata: elenco, lingue e varianti da confrontare con fonti indipendenti.'::text AS reason,
    r.source_url,
    'unverified'::text AS variants_status
   FROM catalog_releases r;

views.name: catalog_cross_source_register
views.definition:
SELECT (a.source_uid || '|'::text) || b.source_uid AS pair_key,
    a.source_uid AS primary_uid,
    b.source_uid AS secondary_uid,
    a.source_language,
    COALESCE(l.label, a.source_language) AS language_label,
    a.set_id AS primary_set,
    b.set_id AS secondary_set,
    a.name,
    COALESCE(c.status, 'pending'::text) AS status,
    c.checked_at,
    c.next_check_at,
    c.last_success_at,
    COALESCE(c.result, '{}'::jsonb) AS result,
    c.last_error,
    b.last_sync_at AS secondary_checked_at,
    b.card_count AS secondary_expected_count,
    b.last_error AS secondary_error,
    (('https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/'::text || a.source_language) || '/sets/'::text) || a.set_id AS primary_url,
    'https://github.com/type-null/PTCG-database'::text AS secondary_url,
    'same_language_and_set_code'::text AS match_basis,
    'unestablished'::text AS independence_status,
    'unverified'::text AS variants_status
   FROM catalog_sync_sets a
     JOIN catalog_sync_sets b ON b.provider = 'atlas'::text AND a.source_language = b.source_language AND lower(a.set_id) = lower(b.set_id)
     LEFT JOIN catalog_language_sources l ON l.source_language = a.source_language
     LEFT JOIN catalog_source_comparisons c ON c.primary_uid = a.source_uid AND c.secondary_uid = b.source_uid
  WHERE a.provider = 'tcgdex'::text AND a.set_id <> '__index__'::text AND a.coverage_scope <> 'digital'::text AND b.coverage_scope <> 'digital'::text;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bindex_printing_page(after_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone, after_key text DEFAULT ''::text, until_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, page_size integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare cap integer:=least(greatest(coalesce(page_size,200),1),500);cutoff timestamptz:=least(coalesce(until_time,statement_timestamp()-interval '1 minute'),statement_timestamp()-interval '1 minute');result jsonb;
begin
 if after_time is null or after_key is null then raise exception 'Cursore inventario mancante';end if;
 with page as materialized(
  select * from public.catalog_printing_inventory where (updated_at,record_key)>(after_time,after_key) and updated_at<=cutoff order by updated_at,record_key limit cap
 ) select jsonb_build_object('contract','bindex-printings-v1','record_type','source_evidence','until',cutoff,
 'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(p)-'canonical_sigla'-'canonical_numero'-'canonical_variante'-'source_entry_key')||jsonb_build_object(
  'canonical_key',case when canonical_sigla is not null then jsonb_build_object('sigla',canonical_sigla,'numero',canonical_numero,'variante',canonical_variante) end,
  'canonical_mapping_status',canonical_mapping_status)
  order by updated_at,record_key) from page p),'[]'::jsonb),
 'next_cursor',(select jsonb_build_object('time',updated_at,'key',record_key) from page order by updated_at desc,record_key desc limit 1),
 'complete',(select count(*)<cap from page)) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bindex_publish_photo(set_code text, card_number integer, printing text, image_language text, image text, image_hd text, image_source text, image_verified boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare previous_url text; accepted_url text; accepted_hd text; accepted_verified boolean;
begin
 if image_language not in ('IT','EN','FR','DE','ES','PT','JP','KOR','CHN','CHN-T','TH','ID','NL','PL','RU','ES-LA') or image_language is null then raise exception 'Lingua della foto non documentata';end if;
 if image is null or image !~ '^https://' or nullif(trim(image_source),'') is null then raise exception 'Foto o fonte non valida';end if;
 select p.immagine into previous_url from public.set_carte_immagini p
 where (p.sigla,p.numero,p.variante,p.lingua)=(set_code,card_number,printing,image_language) for update;
 insert into public.set_carte_immagini(sigla,numero,variante,lingua,immagine,immagine_hd,fonte,verificata)
 values(set_code,card_number,printing,image_language,image,image_hd,image_source,coalesce(image_verified,false))
 on conflict(sigla,numero,variante,lingua) do update set immagine=excluded.immagine,immagine_hd=excluded.immagine_hd,fonte=excluded.fonte,verificata=excluded.verificata
 where not public.set_carte_immagini.verificata or excluded.verificata;
 select p.immagine,p.immagine_hd,p.verificata into accepted_url,accepted_hd,accepted_verified from public.set_carte_immagini p
 where (p.sigla,p.numero,p.variante,p.lingua)=(set_code,card_number,printing,image_language);
 update public.set_carte c set immagine=accepted_url,immagine_hd=accepted_hd,immagine_verificata=accepted_verified
 where (c.sigla,c.numero,c.variante)=(set_code,card_number,printing)
 and (nullif(trim(c.immagine),'') is null or c.immagine=previous_url
  or (image_language='IT' and (not c.immagine_verificata or accepted_verified)))
 -- Once an Italian photo is known, a different language cannot take over the main picture.
 and (image_language='IT' or not exists(select 1 from public.set_carte_immagini p where (p.sigla,p.numero,p.variante,p.lingua)=(set_code,card_number,printing,'IT') and p.immagine=c.immagine));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_apply_card_metadata(items jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
declare answer jsonb;
begin
 if items is null or jsonb_typeof(items)<>'array' or jsonb_array_length(items)>250 then raise exception 'Lotto di metadati non valido';end if;
 with supplied as materialized(
  select * from jsonb_to_recordset(items) x(source_uid text,source_card_id text,source_language text,metadata jsonb,tags text[],evidence jsonb)
 ), facts as materialized(
  select distinct on(c.id)c.id card_id,x.source_card_id,x.source_language,x.evidence,
   jsonb_build_object('id',x.source_card_id,'source_language',x.source_language)||
    (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(k,v),'{}') from jsonb_each(x.metadata) p(k,v)
     where k=any(array['localId','source_name','rarity','types','regulationMark','stage','hp','illustrator','suffix','trainerType','energyType','set'])) patch,
   array(select distinct t from unnest(x.tags)t where split_part(t,':',1)=any(array['rarity','type','regulation','hp','stage','illustrator','category']) and length(t)<=512 order by t) derived_tags
  from supplied x join public.cards c on c.source_uid=x.source_uid and c.source_card_id=x.source_card_id and c.source_language=x.source_language
  where x.source_uid='tcgdex:'||x.source_language||':'||x.source_card_id
   and x.metadata->>'id'=x.source_card_id and x.metadata->>'source_language'=x.source_language
   and x.evidence->>'method'='tcgdex-graphql' and x.evidence->>'endpoint'='https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/graphql' and x.evidence->>'language'=x.source_language
   and not exists(select 1 from supplied other where other.source_uid=x.source_uid and other.metadata is distinct from x.metadata)
  order by c.id
 ), eligible as materialized(
  select e.entry_key,f.* from facts f join public.catalog_search_entries e on e.card_id=f.card_id
  where not(e.manual_overrides ? 'source_payload') and not coalesce((e.source_payload->>'identity_review_required')::boolean,false)
   and((e.entry_key='card:'||f.card_id and e.verification='catalog') or(e.source_payload->>'id'=f.source_card_id and e.source_payload->>'source_language'=f.source_language))
 ), wanted as materialized(
  select q.* from eligible q join public.catalog_search_entries e using(entry_key)
  where not(e.source_payload @> q.patch) or e.source_payload->'metadata_tags' is distinct from to_jsonb(q.derived_tags)
   or e.source_payload->'metadata_evidence' is distinct from q.evidence
   or not(e.manual_overrides ? 'tags') and not(e.tags @> q.derived_tags)
 ), locked as materialized(
  select w.* from wanted w join public.catalog_search_entries e using(entry_key) order by e.entry_key for update of e skip locked
 ), updated as(
  update public.catalog_search_entries e set
   tags=case when e.manual_overrides ? 'tags' then e.tags else
    array(select distinct t from unnest(array(select t from unnest(e.tags)t where not t=any(array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(case when jsonb_typeof(e.source_payload->'metadata_tags')='array' then e.source_payload->'metadata_tags' else '[]'::jsonb end))))||l.derived_tags)t order by t) end,
   source_payload=e.source_payload||l.patch||jsonb_build_object('set',
    (case when jsonb_typeof(e.source_payload->'set')='object' then e.source_payload->'set' else '{}'::jsonb end)||
    (case when jsonb_typeof(l.patch->'set')='object' then l.patch->'set' else '{}'::jsonb end),
    'metadata_tags',l.derived_tags,'metadata_evidence',l.evidence)||
    case when e.verification='catalog' then jsonb_build_object('metadata_scope','card-metadata-only','reference_image_only',true) else '{}'::jsonb end,
   source_url=coalesce(e.source_url,'https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/'||l.source_language||'/cards/'||l.source_card_id),
   search_text=public.catalog_normalize(normalize(concat_ws(' ',e.name,e.set_code,e.collector_number,e.label,array_to_string(e.tags||l.derived_tags,' ')),NFC)),updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  from locked l where e.entry_key=l.entry_key returning e.entry_key
 ), terms as(
  insert into public.catalog_terms(code,label,kind,aliases,parents)
  select distinct t,replace(split_part(t,':',2),'-',' '),split_part(t,':',1),'{}'::text[],'{}'::text[]
  from facts,lateral unnest(derived_tags)t on conflict(code) do nothing returning code
 )select jsonb_build_object('matched',(select count(*) from facts),'updated',(select count(*) from updated),
  'deferred',(select count(*) from wanted)-(select count(*) from locked)) into answer;
 return answer;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_apply_rarity_evidence(items jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
declare answer jsonb;
begin
 if items is null or jsonb_typeof(items)<>'array' or jsonb_array_length(items)>250 then raise exception 'Lotto non valido';end if;
 with supplied as materialized(
  select * from jsonb_to_recordset(items) as x(source_uid text,source_card_id text,source_language text,rarity text,evidence_url text)
 ), facts as materialized(
  select distinct on(c.id) c.id,x.*,public.catalog_rarity_tags(x.rarity,x.source_language) rarity_tags
  from supplied x join public.cards c on c.source_uid=x.source_uid and c.source_card_id=x.source_card_id and c.source_language=x.source_language
  where x.source_uid='tcgdex:'||x.source_language||':'||x.source_card_id and nullif(x.rarity,'') is not null
   and starts_with(x.evidence_url,'https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/'||x.source_language||'/rarities/')
   and not exists(select 1 from supplied other where other.source_uid=x.source_uid and public.catalog_normalize(other.rarity)<>public.catalog_normalize(x.rarity))
  order by c.id,x.rarity
 ), wanted as materialized(
  select e.entry_key,f.* from facts f join public.catalog_search_entries e on e.card_id=f.id
  where not(e.manual_overrides ? 'source_payload')
   and((e.entry_key='card:'||f.id and e.verification='catalog') or
    (e.source_payload->>'id'=f.source_card_id and e.source_payload->>'source_language'=f.source_language and e.source_payload ? 'variant'
     and not coalesce((e.source_payload->>'identity_review_required')::boolean,false)))
   and(nullif(e.source_payload->>'rarity','') is null or public.catalog_normalize(e.source_payload->>'rarity')=public.catalog_normalize(f.rarity))
   and(e.source_payload->>'rarity' is distinct from f.rarity or
    not(e.manual_overrides ? 'tags') and not(e.tags @> f.rarity_tags))
 ), locked as materialized(
  select w.*,e.tags,e.source_payload,e.source_url,e.name,e.set_code,e.collector_number,e.label,e.language
  from wanted w join public.catalog_search_entries e using(entry_key) order by e.entry_key for update of e skip locked
 ), changed as(
  update public.catalog_search_entries e set
   tags=array(select distinct t from unnest(l.tags||l.rarity_tags)t order by t),
   source_payload=l.source_payload||jsonb_build_object('id',l.source_card_id,'source_language',l.source_language,'rarity',l.rarity,
    'rarity_evidence',jsonb_build_object('method','tcgdex-rarity-list','url',l.evidence_url))||
    case when e.verification='catalog' then jsonb_build_object('metadata_scope','card-metadata-only','reference_image_only',true) else '{}'::jsonb end,
   source_url=coalesce(l.source_url,l.evidence_url),updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  from locked l where e.entry_key=l.entry_key returning e.entry_key
 ), terms as(
  insert into public.catalog_terms(code,label,kind,aliases,parents)
  select distinct t,replace(split_part(t,':',2),'-',' '),'rarity',array[replace(split_part(t,':',2),'-',' ')],'{}'::text[]
  from facts,lateral unnest(rarity_tags)t on conflict(code) do nothing returning code
 )select jsonb_build_object('matched',(select count(*) from facts),'updated',(select count(*) from changed),
  'deferred',(select count(*) from wanted)-(select count(*) from locked)) into answer;
 return answer;
end $function$

functions.args: after_id bigint, batch_size integer
functions.name: catalog_backfill_generic_rarity
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_backfill_generic_rarity(after_id bigint DEFAULT 0, batch_size integer DEFAULT 250)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
declare answer jsonb;
begin
 if batch_size is null or batch_size<1 or batch_size>500 then raise exception 'Limite non valido';end if;
 with source_cards as materialized(
  -- Bound the indexed card-id scan BEFORE loading JSON, joining or checking prior repairs.
  select distinct s.card_id from public.catalog_search_entries s
  where s.card_id>after_id and s.verification<>'catalog' and s.source_payload->>'rarity' is not null
  order by s.card_id limit batch_size
 ), evidence as materialized(
  select p.card_id,s.source_payload,s.source_url
  from source_cards p join public.cards c on c.id=p.card_id
  join public.catalog_search_entries g on g.entry_key='card:'||p.card_id
  cross join lateral(
   select e.source_payload,e.source_url from public.catalog_search_entries e
   where e.card_id=p.card_id and e.verification<>'catalog' and e.source_payload->>'rarity' is not null
    and e.source_payload->>'id'=c.source_card_id and e.source_payload->>'source_language'=c.source_language
    and not coalesce((e.source_payload->>'identity_review_required')::boolean,false)
   order by e.updated_at desc,e.entry_key limit 1
  ) s
  where g.verification='catalog' and not(g.manual_overrides ? 'source_payload')
   and(g.source_payload->>'rarity' is distinct from s.source_payload->>'rarity'
    or not(g.manual_overrides ? 'tags') and not(g.tags @> public.catalog_rarity_tags(s.source_payload->>'rarity',c.source_language)))
 ), locked_evidence as materialized(
  select e.* from evidence e join public.catalog_search_entries g on g.entry_key='card:'||e.card_id
  order by g.entry_key for update of g skip locked
 ), updated as(
  update public.catalog_search_entries g set
   tags=array(select distinct t from unnest(g.tags||public.catalog_rarity_tags(e.source_payload->>'rarity',e.source_payload->>'source_language'))t order by t),
   source_payload=g.source_payload||jsonb_build_object('id',e.source_payload->>'id','rarity',e.source_payload->>'rarity','set',e.source_payload->'set',
    'source_language',e.source_payload->>'source_language','metadata_scope','card-metadata-only','reference_image_only',true),
   source_url=e.source_url,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  from locked_evidence e where g.entry_key='card:'||e.card_id returning g.card_id
 ) select jsonb_build_object('updated',(select count(*) from updated),'scanned',(select count(*) from source_cards),
  'deferred',(select count(*) from evidence)-(select count(*) from locked_evidence),
  'next_id',(select max(card_id) from source_cards)) into answer;
 return answer;
end $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_coverage_card_batch(after_id bigint, until_id bigint, batch_size integer DEFAULT 500)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '8s'
 SET work_mem TO '8MB'
 SET jit TO 'off'
AS $function$
 with page as materialized(
 select id,sigla,lingua,source_uid,source_card_id,source_local_id,source_language,image_status,image_url,traits_checked_at,traits_last_error
 from public.cards where id>after_id and id<=until_id order by id limit least(greatest(coalesce(batch_size,500),1),1000)
 ), per_card as materialized(
 select c.*,public.catalog_coverage_provider(c.source_uid) source_provider,coalesce(c.source_language,'und') origin_language,
 public.catalog_coverage_origin(c.source_uid,c.sigla,c.source_card_id,c.source_local_id) origin_set,
 case when c.source_uid like 'tcgdex:%' then 'tcgdex' when c.source_uid like 'atlas:%' then 'atlas' else 'legacy' end provider,
 coalesce(e.tagged,false) tagged,e.printings,coalesce(e.warnings,'[]'::jsonb) warnings,
 c.image_status='placeholder' placeholder,nullif(trim(c.image_url),'') is null missing_image,
 case when e.tagged then 'indexed' when c.traits_checked_at is not null then 'insufficient'
 when c.source_uid is null or c.source_card_id is null or (c.source_uid not like 'tcgdex:%' and c.source_uid not like 'atlas:%') then 'unsupported'
 when c.traits_last_error is not null then 'retry' else 'pending' end metadata_state
 from page c cross join lateral(
 select bool_or(cardinality(x.tags)>0) tagged,count(*) printings,
 jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('entry_key',x.entry_key,'card_id',c.id,'name',x.name,'set_code',x.set_code,'reason',x.reason)) filter(where x.reason is not null) warnings
 from (select e.entry_key,e.tags,e.name,e.set_code,case
 when e.tags @> array['finish:normal'] and(e.tags && array['finish:holo','finish:reverse','visual:shiny'] or e.facts->>'shiny'='true') then 'finish_conflict'
 when e.entry_key like 'tcgdex:%' then case
 when nullif(e.source_payload->>'id','') is not null and c.source_card_id is not null and e.source_payload->>'id'<>c.source_card_id then 'source_identity_conflict'
 when nullif(e.source_payload->>'localId','') is not null and e.collector_number is not null and public.catalog_number(e.source_payload->>'localId')<>public.catalog_number(e.collector_number) then 'number_conflict' end
 end reason from public.catalog_search_entries e where e.card_id=c.id and e.verification<>'catalog')x
 )e
 ), groups as(
 select provider,source_provider,origin_language,origin_set,sigla,lingua,count(*) total,count(*) filter(where tagged) tagged,
 count(*) filter(where missing_image) missing_image,count(*) filter(where placeholder) placeholder,
 count(*) filter(where metadata_state='pending') pending,count(*) filter(where metadata_state='retry') retry,
 count(*) filter(where metadata_state='insufficient') insufficient,count(*) filter(where metadata_state='unsupported') unsupported,sum(printings) printings
 from per_card group by provider,source_provider,origin_language,origin_set,sigla,lingua
 ), warnings as materialized(select w.value item from per_card c cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(c.warnings) w)
 select jsonb_build_object('scanned',(select count(*) from page),'next_id',coalesce((select max(id) from page),after_id),
 'has_more',(select count(*) from page)=least(greatest(coalesce(batch_size,500),1),1000),
 'groups',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g)) from groups g),'[]'::jsonb),
 'warnings',jsonb_build_object('by_reason',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(reason,n) from(select item->>'reason' reason,count(*) n from warnings group by item->>'reason')x),'{}'::jsonb),
 'samples',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(item) from(select item from warnings order by(item->>'card_id')::bigint,item->>'entry_key' limit 30)x),'[]'::jsonb)))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_index_card()
 RETURNS trigger

AS $function$
declare n text; base_tags text[]='{}';
begin
 n:=case when lower(split_part(new.sigla,'@',1))='mfb' then null when nullif(new.source_local_id,'') is not null then public.catalog_number(new.source_local_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_quality_report()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
 SET work_mem TO '16MB'
 SET jit TO 'off'
 SET enable_sort TO 'off'
 SET enable_mergejoin TO 'off'
AS $function$
with card_rows as materialized (
 select id,sigla,lingua,
  case when source_uid like 'tcgdex:%' then 'tcgdex' when source_uid like 'atlas:%' then 'atlas' else 'legacy' end provider,
  image_status='placeholder' placeholder,nullif(trim(image_url),'') is null missing_image,
  traits_checked_at is not null checked,
  source_uid is null or source_card_id is null or (source_uid not like 'tcgdex:%' and source_uid not like 'atlas:%') unsupported,
  traits_last_error is not null retry
 from public.cards
), entries as materialized (
 select e.card_id,
  bool_or(cardinality(e.tags)>0) tagged,
  count(*) printings
 from public.catalog_search_entries e where e.verification<>'catalog' group by e.card_id
), coverage as not materialized (
 select c.id,c.sigla,c.lingua,c.provider,coalesce(e.tagged,false) tagged,coalesce(e.printings,0) printings,
  c.placeholder,c.missing_image,
  case when e.tagged then 'indexed' when c.checked then 'insufficient' when c.unsupported then 'unsupported'
   when c.retry then 'retry' else 'pending' end metadata_state
 from card_rows c left join entries e on e.card_id=c.id
), groups as materialized (
 select provider,sigla,lingua,count(*) total,count(*) filter(where tagged) tagged,
  count(*) filter(where missing_image) missing_image,count(*) filter(where placeholder) placeholder,
  count(*) filter(where metadata_state='pending') pending,count(*) filter(where metadata_state='retry') retry,
  count(*) filter(where metadata_state='insufficient') insufficient,count(*) filter(where metadata_state='unsupported') unsupported,
  sum(printings) printings
 from coverage group by provider,sigla,lingua
), warnings as materialized (
 select * from (select e.entry_key,e.card_id,e.name,e.set_code,
  case when e.tags @> array['finish:normal'] and (e.tags && array['finish:holo','finish:reverse','visual:shiny'] or e.facts->>'shiny'='true') then 'finish_conflict'
   when e.entry_key like 'tcgdex:%' then case
   when nullif(e.source_payload->>'id','') is not null and c.source_card_id is not null
    and e.source_payload->>'id'<>c.source_card_id then 'source_identity_conflict'
   when nullif(e.source_payload->>'localId','') is not null and e.collector_number is not null
    and public.catalog_number(e.source_payload->>'localId')<>public.catalog_number(e.collector_number) then 'number_conflict'
   else null end
   else null end reason
 from public.catalog_search_entries e join public.cards c on c.id=e.card_id
 where e.verification<>'catalog') checked where reason is not null
), shared_images as materialized (
 select immagine,count(distinct (sigla,numero,variante)) identities
 from public.set_carte_immagini where verificata and nullif(trim(immagine),'') is not null
 group by immagine having count(distinct (sigla,numero,variante))>1
)
select jsonb_build_object(
 'generated_at',now(),
 'totals',(select jsonb_build_object('total',coalesce(sum(total),0),'tagged',coalesce(sum(tagged),0),'missing_image',coalesce(sum(missing_image),0),'placeholder',coalesce(sum(placeholder),0),'pending',coalesce(sum(pending),0),'retry',coalesce(sum(retry),0),'insufficient',coalesce(sum(insufficient),0),'unsupported',coalesce(sum(unsupported),0),'printings',coalesce(sum(printings),0)) from groups),
 'groups',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) order by total desc,provider,sigla,lingua) from groups g),'[]'::jsonb),
 'warnings',jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from warnings where reason is not null),
  'by_reason',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(reason,n) from(select reason,count(*) n from warnings where reason is not null group by reason)x),'{}'::jsonb),
  'samples',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from(select entry_key,card_id,name,set_code,reason from warnings where reason is not null order by card_id,entry_key limit 30)x),'[]'::jsonb),
  'shared_verified_images',(select count(*) from shared_images)),
 'published',jsonb_build_object(
  'total',(select count(*) from public.set_carte where not eliminata),
  'tagged',(select count(*) from public.set_carte where not eliminata and cardinality(tag)>0),
  'without_image',(select count(*) from public.set_carte where not eliminata and nullif(trim(immagine),'') is null),
  'verified_images',(select count(*) from public.set_carte where not eliminata and immagine_verificata and nullif(trim(immagine),'') is not null))
)
$function$

  select label,coalesce(translations->coalesce(source_language,'en')->label,translations->'en'->label) codes from normalized,aliases
 ), expanded as(
  select 'rarity:'||replace(label,' ','-') tag from resolved where label<>''
  union all select codes#>>'{}' from resolved where jsonb_typeof(codes)='string'
  union all select x from resolved,lateral jsonb_array_elements_text(case when jsonb_typeof(codes)='array' then codes else '[]'::jsonb end) x
 )select coalesce(array_agg(distinct tag order by tag) filter(where tag is not null),'{}') from expanded
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_repair_rarity_tags(after_key text DEFAULT ''::text, batch_size integer DEFAULT 250)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
declare answer jsonb;
begin
 if batch_size is null or batch_size<1 or batch_size>500 then raise exception 'Limite non valido';end if;
 with page as materialized(
  select entry_key from public.catalog_search_entries where verification<>'catalog' and entry_key>after_key order by entry_key limit batch_size
 ), facts as materialized(
  select e.entry_key,e.tags,e.source_payload,e.source_url,e.search_text,e.name,e.set_code,e.collector_number,e.label,
   c.source_language lang,coalesce(e.source_payload->>'rarity',e.source_payload->'metadata'->>'rarity') rarity,
   case when e.source_payload->>'provider'='card-atlas' then e.source_payload->'metadata'->>'card_type' end card_type
  from page p join public.catalog_search_entries e using(entry_key) join public.cards c on c.id=e.card_id
  where e.source_payload->>'id'=c.source_card_id and not(e.manual_overrides ? 'source_payload') and
   ((e.source_payload->>'provider'='card-atlas' and c.source_uid='atlas:'||c.source_language||':'||c.source_card_id) or
    (e.source_payload->>'source_language'=c.source_language and c.source_uid='tcgdex:'||c.source_language||':'||c.source_card_id))
 ), desired as materialized(
  select f.*,
   array(select distinct t from unnest(
    array_remove(f.tags,case when nullif(card_type,'') is not null then 'card-type:'||trim(both '-' from regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(normalize(card_type,NFD),U&'[\0300-\036f]','','g')),'[^[:alnum:]]+','-','g')) end)
    ||public.catalog_rarity_tags(rarity,lang)||case when nullif(card_type,'') is not null then array['card-type:'||replace(public.catalog_normalize(normalize(card_type,NFC)),' ','-')] else '{}'::text[] end)t order by t) new_tags,
   case when source_payload->>'provider'='card-atlas' then source_payload||jsonb_build_object('source_language',lang)||
    case when rarity is not null then jsonb_build_object('rarity',rarity) else '{}'::jsonb end else source_payload end new_payload,
   case when lang='ja' then public.catalog_normalize(normalize(concat_ws(' ',name,set_code,collector_number,label),NFC)) else search_text end new_search
  from facts f
 ), locked as materialized(
  select d.* from desired d join public.catalog_search_entries e using(entry_key)
  where d.new_tags is distinct from e.tags or d.new_payload is distinct from e.source_payload or d.new_search is distinct from e.search_text
  order by e.entry_key for update of e skip locked
 ), changed as(
  update public.catalog_search_entries e set tags=l.new_tags,source_payload=l.new_payload,search_text=l.new_search,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  from locked l where e.entry_key=l.entry_key returning e.entry_key
 ), terms as(
  insert into public.catalog_terms(code,label,kind,aliases,parents)
  select distinct t,replace(split_part(t,':',2),'-',' '),split_part(t,':',1),'{}'::text[],'{}'::text[]
  from desired,lateral unnest(new_tags)t where t like 'rarity:%' or t like 'card-type:%' on conflict(code) do nothing returning code
 )select jsonb_build_object('scanned',(select count(*) from page),'updated',(select count(*) from changed),
   'next_key',(select max(entry_key) from page)) into answer;
 return answer;
end $function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '8s'
AS $function$
declare changed integer;
begin
 if jsonb_typeof(new_manifest) is distinct from 'object' or new_manifest->'coverage_detail'->>'comparison_scope' is distinct from 'expected_source_links'
  or coalesce((new_manifest->>'manifest_count')::int,0)<1 or (new_manifest->>'manifest_count')::int>5000
  or new_manifest->>'resolved_count' is null or (new_manifest->>'resolved_count')::int<0 or (new_manifest->>'resolved_count')::int>(new_manifest->>'manifest_count')::int
  or new_manifest->'coverage_detail'->>'missing_count' is null or (new_manifest->'coverage_detail'->>'missing_count')::int<0
  or nullif(new_manifest->>'manifest_digest','') is null or nullif(new_manifest->>'resolved_digest','') is null
  or nullif(new_manifest->>'coverage_checked_at','') is null then raise exception 'Confronto degli identificativi non valido';end if;
 update public.catalog_sync_sets set
  manifest_count=(new_manifest->>'manifest_count')::int,resolved_count=(new_manifest->>'resolved_count')::int,
  manifest_digest=new_manifest->>'manifest_digest',resolved_digest=new_manifest->>'resolved_digest',coverage_scope='physical',
  coverage_checked_at=(new_manifest->>'coverage_checked_at')::timestamptz,coverage_detail=new_manifest->'coverage_detail',
  manifest_last_attempt_at=clock_timestamp(),manifest_last_error=null,
  manifest_next_check_at=clock_timestamp()+case when (new_manifest->'coverage_detail'->>'missing_count')::int>0 then interval '1 day' else interval '7 days' end
 where source_uid=wanted_uid and set_id=expected_set_id and coverage_checked_at is not distinct from previous_check and coverage_scope<>'digital';
 get diagnostics changed=row_count;return changed=1;
end $function$

 with grouped as(
  select m.visual_group_key,
  (array_agg(m.asset_key order by(m.availability='available') desc,(m.match_mode is not null) desc,(m.source_language='en') desc,m.asset_key))[1] representative,
  array_agg(distinct m.source_language order by m.source_language) languages,array_agg(distinct m.source_code order by m.source_code) source_codes,
  array_agg(m.asset_key order by m.asset_key) member_asset_keys,count(*) reference_count,bool_or(m.match_mode is not null) has_links
  from public.catalog_visual_group_members m where m.visual_group_key>after_group and(filter_kind is null or m.kind=filter_kind)
  group by m.visual_group_key having(include_unlinked or bool_or(m.match_mode is not null))
  and(filter_language is null or bool_or(m.source_language='und' or public.catalog_visual_language(m.source_language)=public.catalog_visual_language(filter_language)))
 ),page as(select * from grouped order by visual_group_key limit page_size+1),body as(
  select to_jsonb(a)||jsonb_build_object('group_key',g.visual_group_key,'languages',g.languages,'source_codes',g.source_codes,'member_asset_keys',g.member_asset_keys,
   'reference_count',g.reference_count,'has_links',g.has_links) row,g.visual_group_key from page g join public.catalog_visual_assets a on a.asset_key=g.representative
  order by g.visual_group_key limit page_size
 )select jsonb_build_object('contract','bindex-visual-groups-v1','grouped',true,'results',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(b.row order by b.visual_group_key) from body b),'[]'::jsonb),
 'has_more',(select count(*)>page_size from page),'next_key',(select max(visual_group_key) from body),'grouping_basis','exact-image-hash+kind+scope',
 'image_match_is_not_verified_by_automatic_link',true) into result;return result;

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_visual_matches(wanted_assets text[], after_key text DEFAULT ''::text, page_size integer DEFAULT 24, include_review boolean DEFAULT false, filter_language text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '5s'
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
 if page_size is null or page_size<1 or page_size>100 or coalesce(cardinality(wanted_assets),0)>1000 then raise exception 'Limite non valido';end if;
 with refs as materialized(
  select a.*,
  case when coalesce(to_jsonb(a)->'manual_overrides','{}') ? 'source_code' and not(coalesce(to_jsonb(a)->'manual_overrides','{}') ? 'match_code')
   then a.source_code else coalesce(a.match_code,a.source_code) end effective_code,
  case when coalesce(to_jsonb(a)->'manual_overrides','{}') ? 'tag_code' and not(coalesce(to_jsonb(a)->'manual_overrides','{}') ? 'tag_codes')
   then array_remove(array[a.tag_code],null) when cardinality(a.tag_codes)>0 then a.tag_codes else array_remove(array[a.tag_code],null) end effective_tags
  from public.catalog_visual_assets a where a.asset_key=any(wanted_assets)
 ), blocked as materialized(
  select l.entry_key from public.catalog_visual_links l join refs r using(asset_key) where l.status='rejected'
 ), prefixes as materialized(
  select r.asset_key,'tcgdex:'||lang||':'||r.effective_code prefix from refs r
  cross join lateral unnest(case when r.source_language='und' then array['en','it','fr','de','es','pt','ja','ko','zh-tw','zh-cn','id','th','es-mx','nl','pl','ru']
   else array[public.catalog_visual_language(r.source_language)] end) lang
  where r.match_mode='tcgdex-set' and r.scope='physical' and r.availability='available' and lower(r.effective_code)<>'base1'
 ), candidates as(
  select e.entry_key,r.asset_key from refs r join public.catalog_search_entries e on e.tags && r.effective_tags
  where r.match_mode='tag' and r.scope='physical' and r.availability='available'
   and(filter_language is null or public.catalog_visual_entry_languages(e.source_payload,e.language,e.release_code) && array[public.catalog_visual_language(filter_language),'und'])
   and(include_review or r.source_language='und' or public.catalog_visual_entry_languages(e.source_payload,e.language,e.release_code) && array[public.catalog_visual_language(r.source_language),'und'])
  union all
  select e.entry_key,p.asset_key from prefixes p join public.cards c on
   (c.source_uid collate "C")>=p.prefix||'-' and (c.source_uid collate "C")<p.prefix||'.' and starts_with(c.source_uid,p.prefix||'-')
  join public.catalog_search_entries e on e.card_id=c.id
  where filter_language is null or public.catalog_visual_entry_languages(e.source_payload,e.language,e.release_code) && array[public.catalog_visual_language(filter_language),'und']
 ), automatic as(
  select e.entry_key,case when r.match_mode='tag' then 'source' else 'candidate' end status,'candidate'::text image_match_status,null::text position,
   e.source_url evidence_url,'automatic'::text method,r.asset_key reference_asset_key,e.card_id,e.verification
  from candidates k join refs r using(asset_key) join public.catalog_search_entries e using(entry_key)
  where include_review or r.source_language='und' or exists(select 1 from public.cards c where c.id=e.card_id and public.catalog_visual_actual_language(e.source_payload,e.language,c.source_language,e.release_code,
   (e.manual_overrides ? 'language') or (c.manual_overrides ? 'lingua'))=public.catalog_visual_language(r.source_language))
 ), manual as(
  select l.entry_key,l.status,l.image_match_status,l.position,l.evidence_url,'reviewed-link'::text method,l.asset_key reference_asset_key,e.card_id,e.verification
  from public.catalog_visual_links l join refs r using(asset_key) join public.catalog_search_entries e using(entry_key) where r.scope='physical' and l.status<>'rejected'
 ), selected as materialized(select * from automatic union all select * from manual), variant_cards as materialized(
  -- Carry identity fields through candidates instead of re-reading every entry twice.
  select distinct s.card_id from selected s where s.verification<>'catalog' and(filter_language is null or exists(select 1 from public.catalog_search_entries e join public.cards c on c.id=e.card_id
    where e.entry_key=s.entry_key and public.catalog_visual_actual_language(e.source_payload,e.language,c.source_language,e.release_code,
    (e.manual_overrides ? 'language') or (c.manual_overrides ? 'lingua'))=public.catalog_visual_language(filter_language)))
  union select e.card_id from blocked b join public.catalog_search_entries e using(entry_key) where e.verification<>'catalog'
 ), deduplicated as(
  select distinct on(s.entry_key) s.entry_key,s.status,s.image_match_status,s.position,s.evidence_url,s.method,s.reference_asset_key
  from selected s left join variant_cards v on v.card_id=s.card_id
  where not exists(select 1 from blocked b where b.entry_key=s.entry_key)
   and(s.verification<>'catalog' or v.card_id is null)
   and(filter_language is null or exists(select 1 from public.catalog_search_entries e join public.cards c on c.id=e.card_id
    where e.entry_key=s.entry_key and public.catalog_visual_actual_language(e.source_payload,e.language,c.source_language,e.release_code,
    (e.manual_overrides ? 'language') or (c.manual_overrides ? 'lingua'))=public.catalog_visual_language(filter_language)))
  order by s.entry_key,(s.method='reviewed-link') desc,(s.status='verified') desc,(s.image_match_status='verified') desc,s.reference_asset_key
 ), page as(select * from deduplicated where entry_key>after_key order by entry_key limit page_size+1), body as(
  select p.*,e.name,e.collector_number,e.set_code,e.language,e.tags,e.release_year,e.release_code,c.id card_id,c.image_url reference_image_url,
   public.catalog_visual_actual_language(e.source_payload,e.language,c.source_language,e.release_code,
    (e.manual_overrides ? 'language') or (c.manual_overrides ? 'lingua')) actual_language,
   i.canonical_sigla,i.canonical_numero,i.canonical_variante,i.canonical_mapping_status
  from page p join public.catalog_search_entries e using(entry_key) join public.cards c on c.id=e.card_id
  left join public.catalog_printing_inventory i on i.record_key=e.entry_key and not i.deleted order by p.entry_key limit page_size
 )select jsonb_build_object('results',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b) order by b.entry_key) from body b),'[]'::jsonb),
  'has_more',(select count(*)>page_size from page),'next_key',(select max(entry_key) from body),'position_unknown_when_null',true,
  'image_match_is_not_verified_by_automatic_link',true) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.identify_catalog_cards(tokens text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[], required_tags text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[], card_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, card_denominator text DEFAULT NULL::text, wanted_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, wanted_language text DEFAULT NULL::text, observations jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, page_offset integer DEFAULT 0, page_size integer DEFAULT 24)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '8s'
AS $function$
 with query as(select case when cardinality(tokens)>0 then to_tsquery('simple',array_to_string(array(select quote_literal(public.catalog_normalize(t))||':*' from unnest(tokens) t where public.catalog_normalize(t)<>''),' & ')) else null end q),
 candidates as materialized(
  select e.*,c.image_url as reference_image_url,c.image_status,
   e.facts as known_facts
  from public.catalog_search_entries e join public.cards c on c.id=e.card_id cross join query q
  where (q.q is null or e.search_vector@@q.q) and e.tags@>required_tags
   and(card_number is null or (e.collector_number=public.catalog_number(card_number) or card_denominator is null and 'family:battle-academy'=any(e.tags) and e.deck_number::text=public.catalog_number(card_number)))
   and(card_denominator is null or e.denominator=card_denominator)
   and(wanted_year is null or e.release_year=wanted_year)
   and(wanted_language is null or e.language=wanted_language)
 ),
 ranked as(
  select c.*,s.matched,s.contradicted,s.unknown,s.matched*3-s.contradicted*4 as score
  from candidates c cross join lateral(
   select count(*) filter(where c.known_facts->o.key=o.value)::integer matched,
    count(*) filter(where c.known_facts ? o.key and c.known_facts->o.key<>o.value)::integer contradicted,
    count(*) filter(where not(c.known_facts ? o.key))::integer unknown
   from jsonb_each(observations) o where o.value in ('true'::jsonb,'false'::jsonb)
  ) s
 ),
 deduplicated as(
  -- A base record is only a fallback when no precise variant of that card matched.
  select * from ranked r where r.verification<>'catalog' or not exists(select 1 from ranked p where (p.card_id=r.card_id or 'family:my-first-battle'=any(r.tags) and 'family:my-first-battle'=any(p.tags) and p.name=r.name and p.language=r.language) and p.verification<>'catalog')
 ),
 page as(select * from deduplicated order by score desc,case verification when 'reviewed' then 2 when 'source' then 1 else 0 end desc,card_id,entry_key limit least(greatest(page_size,1),48) offset least(greatest(page_offset,0),10000))
 select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from deduplicated),'results',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page)-'search_vector'-'search_text'-'source_payload') from page),'[]'::jsonb))

constraints.name: bindex_required_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM nome), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM sigla), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND array_position(tag, NULL::text) IS NULL)

constraints.name: catalog_code_reviews_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'verified'::text AND proposed_code IS NOT NULL AND proposed_code ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9.-]*( [A-Z0-9]+)?$'::text OR status <> 'verified'::text AND proposed_code IS NULL)

constraints.name: catalog_entry_cardmarket_url_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (cardmarket_url IS NULL OR cardmarket_url ~ '^https://www[.]cardmarket[.]com/it/Pokemon/Products/[^?#]+$'::text OR cardmarket_id IS NOT NULL AND cardmarket_id > 0 AND cardmarket_url = ('https://www.cardmarket.com/it/Pokemon/Products?idProduct='::text || cardmarket_id::text))

constraints.name: catalog_packaging_candidates_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (language = 'und'::text AND language_status = 'unknown'::text OR (language = ANY (ARRAY['INT'::text, 'IT'::text, 'FR'::text, 'DE'::text, 'ES'::text, 'PT'::text, 'JP'::text, 'KOR'::text, 'CHN'::text, 'CHN-T'::text, 'ID'::text, 'TH'::text])) AND language_status = 'documented'::text)

constraints.name: catalog_packaging_candidates_check1

constraints.name: catalog_packaging_candidates_packaging_types_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (cardinality(packaging_types) > 0 AND packaging_types <@ ARRAY['S1'::text, 'S2'::text, 'S3'::text, 'S4'::text] AND array_position(packaging_types, NULL::text) IS NULL)

constraints.name: catalog_packaging_links_check

constraints.name: catalog_printing_inventory_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (language = 'und'::text AND (language_status = ANY (ARRAY['unknown'::text, 'conflict'::text])) OR language <> 'und'::text AND language_status = 'documented'::text)

constraints.name: catalog_printing_inventory_check1

constraints.name: catalog_printing_inventory_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (image_status = 'missing'::text AND image_url IS NULL AND image_hd IS NULL OR (image_status = ANY (ARRAY['candidate'::text, 'verified'::text])) AND scope = 'printing'::text AND language <> 'und'::text AND image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_source_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url ~~ 'https://%'::text AND image_source_url ~~ 'https://%'::text)
